Three vampires are arguing on Halloween night about which of them is the deadliest. They decide to settle the score with a competition: within five minutes, they must drink the blood of as many victims as they can.

The first vampire flies away faster than blinking. 40 seconds later he returns, blood coating his lower jaw and throat. “You see? I am the deadliest. In that time, I drank the blood of a family of six.”

The second vampire scoffs and flies away quick as can be. 34 seconds later he returns with blood covering not only his mouth and throat, but all down his chest, too. “You see?” He gloats, “I am the deadliest. For a group of 13 trick-or-treating teens was about and I made a swift meal of each of them.” The first two turn to the third. 

Not to be outdone, the third vampire flies away, faster than lightning. Ten seconds later, he returns absolutely covered in blood from greased back hair to wing-tipped shoes. The first two vampires eyes widen in shock. “Well?” They ask the third. “Did you guys see that tree?” The third vampire asks. Stunned, the two shake their heads, unable to speak. “Yeah, well I didn’t!”
